newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - Portugal spreads vs Bunds, Spanish Bonos.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Portugal spreads vs Bunds, Spanish Bonos.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of three banks and one brokerage.
Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

-The 10 year bonds are likely to follow the weaker tone of the Spanish Bonos after the Bank of Spain left the repo unchanged. But the strength of the dollar will act as a brake to losses and probably help narrow spread with Bunds. The curve unlikely to steepen as local money rates showing little change, traders said.
